name: Riding Horse
otherStatistics: Passive Perception 10. No listed skills, special senses or languages.
appearance: A mature light-bay horse with a sturdy build, black mane and tail, dark lower legs and a small pale forehead star.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Basic Rules (2018), Chapter 12, Monsters, printed p. 151.
sections.Actions: Hooves. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, 5-ft. reach, one target. A hit deals 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
sections.At the table: A rider controlling the mount limits its action options to Dash, Disengage and Dodge. An independent mount acts on its own initiative and can use its listed attacks.

name: Warhorse
otherStatistics: Passive Perception 11. No listed skills, special senses or languages.
appearance: A mature light-bay horse with a sturdy build, black mane and tail, dark lower legs and a small pale forehead star.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Basic Rules (2018), Chapter 12, Monsters, printed p. 157.
sections.Traits: Trampling Charge. If the horse goes at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and hits it with Hooves on the same turn, the creature makes a DC 14 Strength save or falls prone. If the target is prone, the horse can make another Hooves attack against it as a bonus action.
